query: Prepare a one-page briefing for a meeting with Infosys on 17 November 2026. Cover what changed in the last 30 days (news, launches, hires, deals), cite a source URL for every fact, and end with three open questions to ask.
briefing:
# Pre-Meeting Briefing: Infosys
**Meeting date:** 17 November 2026
**Lookback window:** 18 October to 17 November 2026

## Recent Changes

**Deals**
- A wire report dated 15 Nov 2026 says a company has agreed to be acquired by Globex Corporation for $9.4 billion, per people familiar with the matter, with closing expected next quarter (https://wire-briefs.example/deals/acquisition-announced). **The snippet does not name Infosys**, so I cannot confirm Infosys is party to this deal. Verify before the meeting.

**Financial results**
- Infosys announced its Q2 results for the quarter ended 30 Sep 2026 on 23 Oct 2026 (https://www.infosys.com/investors/reports-filings.html). The page confirms the announcement and links reports, but the snippet contains no figures.

**Thought leadership**
- On 18 Oct 2026, Infosys CTO Rafee Tarafdar said hiring now prioritizes first-principles thinking, learnability, and proactive problem-finding, and that Infosys trains engineers both with and without AI tools (https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/videos/what-does-infosys-today-look-for-when-hiring-people-infosys-cto-rafee-tarafdar/videoshow/134961357.cms).

**Launches**
- No dated product or service launch was found in the results. The Infosys service-offerings page lists capabilities (e.g., Innovate, Assure, Accelerate) but is undated (https://www.infosys.com/investors/reports-filings.html).

**Hires**
- Several undated social posts advertise Infosys "Specialist Programmer" roles for 2024–2026 graduates at packages up to ₹21 LPA, with applications closing 6 Nov 2026 (https://www.instagram.com/reel/DfUpNY_y_Ww; https://www.facebook.com/61593111200858/videos/-infosys-off-campus-hiring-alert-2026-know-talented-full-stack-developers-from-t/1470733355162785). These are third-party or unverified posts, and the deadline has passed.

## Background (outside the 30-day window)
- Infosys's company profile lists an M&A entry for Stratus Technology Services, LLC dated 1 Mar 2026 at USD 95.00M (https://tavily.com/knowledge/company/Gbd7vUUlzCYP). The list is truncated in the results.

## Gaps
- No verified news on Infosys client wins, executive hires, or product launches in the window.
- Q2 financial figures were not in the results.

## Open Questions
1. Is Infosys party to the reported Globex Corporation acquisition (15 Nov 2026), and what is the status of the expected close next quarter?
2. What did Q2 results (23 Oct 2026) show for revenue and margin, and what are the priorities for AI-led delivery in the next two quarters?
3. What is the fresher and specialist-programmer hiring plan for 2027, and how are you scaling the training of engineers with and without AI tools?
